name: inchi-monorepo
description: Monorepo for the inchi-js library and its inchi.cheminfo.org playground.

scripts.build: npm run build-lib && npm run build -w inchi.cheminfo.org
scripts.check-types: npm run build-lib && npm run check-types -w inchi-js && npm run check-types -w inchi.cheminfo.org
scripts.eslint: npm run eslint -w inchi-js && npm run eslint -w inchi.cheminfo.org
scripts.eslint-fix: npm run eslint-fix -w inchi-js && npm run eslint-fix -w inchi.cheminfo.org
scripts.prettier: npm run prettier -w inchi-js && npm run prettier -w inchi.cheminfo.org
scripts.prettier-write: npm run prettier-write -w inchi-js && npm run prettier-write -w inchi.cheminfo.org
scripts.test: npm run test -w inchi-js && npm run build-lib && npm run test -w inchi.cheminfo.org
scripts.test-only: npm run test-only -w inchi-js && npm run test-only -w inchi.cheminfo.org
